test_title: PYST 43 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. A robot built to tackle a challenging challenge served as the students' final assignment.

Q. The code that would enable the machine to traverse a maze was written over the course of weeks.

R. Their engineering, programming, and design abilities came together to create it.

S. Their commitment and cooperation were demonstrated by the robot's faultless performance.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. P, R, Q, S .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph describes the process of designing and building a robot as part of a final assignment.
 
• Sentence P introduces the subject of the paragraph: a robot built as the students' final assignment.
 
• Sentence R follows logically, elaborating on the students' skills that contributed to building the robot.
 
• Sentence Q describes the detailed process of writing the code, which was a critical part of the assignment.
 
• Sentence S concludes the paragraph, highlighting the success of the robot's performance and the students' dedication.

Correct sequence: *P, R, Q, S*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When rearranging sentences, always identify the main subject or topic sentence, which is typically the first sentence of the paragraph.
 
• Look for sentences that elaborate on or provide details about the subject to follow logically.
 
• Conclude with a sentence that sums up the topic or provides an outcome.
